name: TX-03
label: Likely R

key_factors: Incumbent Keith Self running with a fundraising edge
No public polling of the race
model.rationale: The district's R+11 lean, Self's incumbency and fundraising advantage, and markets pricing his win at 94% all point to a comfortable Republican hold. Democrat Evan Hunt's modest fundraising gives little evidence of a serious threat.
model.watch: A surge in Democratic outside spending or a polling surprise showing Hunt within single digits would warrant revisiting.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Republican Keith Self seeks a third term in this Collin County-area district, which leans about eleven points Republican at the presidential level. Self has out-raised Democratic challenger Evan Hunt and holds a large cash advantage, with outside groups supporting him and none opposing. No public polls of the race are available, and no expert raters have flagged it as competitive.

Prediction markets give Self roughly a 94% chance of winning. The fundamentals point to a Republican margin in the high single digits, consistent with the district's lean adjusted for incumbency and a favorable environment for the party. Hunt's fundraising, while respectable for a challenger, does not suggest the resources needed to close that gap.
